beats.what: Hyderabad firefighters responded to fires on Sunday and Monday; major ones hit industrial units, medical establishments and a firecracker shop.
beats.why: Festival nights stack many small ignition sources into a few hours, which stretches fire crews.
beats.care: Store crackers away from buildings and keep the fire helpline number handy.
